elements.name: INNOVATIVE ENGINE DESIGN & RIGOROUS TESTING
elements.description: are at the heart of Generac's success in providing the most reliable generators possible. Generac's G-Force engine lineup offers added peace of mind and reliability for when you need it the most. The G-Force series engines are purpose built and designed to handle the rigors of extended run times in high temperatures and extreme operating conditions.

elements.name: MOBILE LINK™ REMOTE MONITORING
elements.description: FREE with every Guardian Series Home standby generator. Allows you to monitor the status of your generator from anywhere in the world using a smartphone, tablet, or PC. Easily access information such as the current operating status and maintenance alerts. Connect your account to your authorized service dealer for fast, friendly and proactive service. With Mobile Link, you are taken care of before the next power outage.

elements.text: This state-of-the-art power maximizing regulation system is standard on all Generac models. It provides optimized FAST RESPONSE to changing load conditions and MAXIMUM MOTOR STARTING CAPABILITY by electronically torque-matching the surge loads to the engine. Digital voltage regulation at ±1%.

elements.name: TRUE POWER™ ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY
elements.description: Superior harmonics and sine wave form produce less than 5% Total Harmonic Distortion for utility quality power. This allows confident operation of sensitive electronic equipment and micro-chip based appliances, such as variable speed HVAC systems.

elements.text: NEMA MG1-22 EVALUATION √ MOTOR STARTING ABILITY

elements.name: Generac G-Force design
elements.description: Maximizes engine 'breathing' for increased fuel efficiency. Plateau honed cylinder walls and plasma moly rings helps the engine run cooler, reducing oil consumption resulting in longer engine life.

elements.name: 'Spiny-lok' cast iron cylinder walls
elements.description: Rigid construction and added durability provide long engine life.

elements.name: Electronic ignition/spark advance
elements.description: These features combine to assure smooth, quick starting every time.

elements.name: Full pressure lubrication system
elements.description: Pressurized lubrication to all vital bearings means better performance, less maintenance and longer engine life. Now featuring up to a 2 year/200 hour oil change interval.

elements.name: Low oil pressure shutdown system
elements.description: Shutdown protection prevents catastrophic engine damage due to low oil.

elements.name: High temperature shutdown
elements.description: Prevents damage due to overheating.

elements.name: Revolving field
elements.description: Allows for a smaller, light weight unit that operates 25% more efficiently than a revolving armature generator.

elements.name: Skewed stator
elements.description: Produces a smooth output waveform for compatibility with electronic equipment.

elements.name: Displaced phase excitation
elements.description: Maximizes motor starting capability.

elements.name: Automatic voltage regulation
elements.description: Regulates the output voltage to ±1%, preventing damaging voltage spikes.

elements.name: True Power Technology
elements.description: Less than 5% total harmonic distortion (THD).

elements.name: Auto/Manual/Off illuminated buttons
elements.description: Selects the operating mode and provides easy, at-a-glance status indication in any condition.

elements.name: Sealed, raised buttons
elements.description: Smooth, weather-resistant user interface for programming and operations.

elements.name: Utility voltage sensing
elements.description: Constantly monitors utility voltage; defaults 156 V dropout, 190 V pick up.

elements.name: Utility interrupt delay
elements.description: Prevents nuisance start-ups of the engine; adjustable 2-1500 seconds from factory default setting of 5 seconds by a qualified dealer.

elements.name: Voltage selection options
elements.description: Output voltage is selectable through the controller from 220 V, 230 V, or 240 V.

elements.name: Engine warm-up
elements.description: Ensures engine is ready to assume the load, setpoint approximately 5 seconds.

elements.name: Engine cool-down
elements.description: Allows engine to cool prior to shutdown, setpoint approximately 1 minute.

elements.name: Programmable seven day exercise
elements.description: Operates engine to prevent oil seal drying and damage between power outages by running the generator for 5 minutes every other week. Also offers a selectable setting for Weekly, Bi-Weekly, or Monthly operation providing flexibility and potentially lower fuel costs to the owner.

elements.name: Smart battery charger
elements.description: Delivers charge to the battery only when needed at varying rates depending on outdoor air temperature. Compatible with lead acid and AGM-style batteries.

elements.name: Main line circuit breaker
elements.description: Protects generator from overload.

elements.name: Electronic governor
elements.description: Maintains constant 50 Hz frequency.

elements.name: SAE weather protective enclosure
elements.description: Sound attenuated enclosures ensure quiet operation and protection against mother nature, withstanding winds up to 150 mph. Hinged key locking roof panel for security. Lift-out front for easy access to all routine maintenance items. Electrostatically applied textured epoxy paint for added durability.

elements.name: Enclosed critical grade muffler
elements.description: Quiet, critical grade muffler is mounted inside the unit to prevent injuries.

elements.name: Small, compact, attractive
elements.description: Makes for an easy, eye appealing installation, as close as 18" away from a building.

elements.name: 1 ft (305 mm) flexible fuel line connector
elements.description: Absorbs any generator vibration when connected to rigid pipe.

elements.name: Direct-to-dirt composite mounting pad
elements.description: Complex lattice design prevents settling or sinking of the generator system.

elements.name: Integral sediment trap
elements.description: Prevents particles and moisture from entering the fuel regulator and engine, prolonging engine life.

elements.name: Ability to view generator status
elements.description: Monitor the generator via a smartphone, tablet, or computer at any time via the Mobile Link application for complete peace of mind

elements.name: Ability to view generator Exercise/Run and Total Hours
elements.description: Review the generator's complete protection profile for exercise hours and total hours

elements.name: Ability to view generator maintenance information
elements.description: Provides maintenance information for your specific model generator when scheduled maintenance is due

elements.name: Monthly report with previous month's activity.
elements.description: Detailed monthly reports provide historical generator information

elements.description: Built in battery diagnostics displaying current state of the battery

(All ratings in accordance with BS5514, ISO3046 and DIN6271). * Maximum kilovolt amps and current are subject to and limited by such factors as fuel Btu/megajoule content, ambient temperature, altitude, engine power and condition, etc. Maximum power decreases about 3.5 percent for each 1,000 feet (304.8 meters) above sea level; and also will decrease about 1 percent for each 6 °C (10 °F) above 16 °C (60 °F).
